raw_market.description:
In the first half of the NFL game between 49ers and Seahawks, scheduled for October 11 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the 49ers score 7 or more points in the first half.

If the 49ers score less than 7 points in the first half, this market will resolve to "Under".

This market is based solely on the 49ers's first half score.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
